_comment: Known token differences between the custom UIs (AVR-362, narrow slice). An entry is (token, service, value): if the service's value changes to anything else it is a NEW divergence and the test fails. Entries may only be removed as AVR-362 converges the services; do not add one to make a run pass. 'reference' is 'any' (seen when comparing services to each other) or 'tokens.json' (seen only when docs/design/foundation/tokens.json exists).

allow.reason: Single-form page; DESIGN.md Layout allows 640px for single-form pages while the portal and Audible use 720px. Decide in AVR-362 whether this stays a named variant.
Audit A2 and DESIGN.md One Wordmark Rule: the wordmark exists in two sizes; Kindle draws a third.
Audit A2: the Audible topbar is left-aligned at 1.25rem; DESIGN.md replaces it with the shared wordmark header.
Audit A2: Kindle tracks the wordmark at 0.28em; the house style is 0.34em.
Audit A2: the Audible topbar tracks at 0.3em; the house style is 0.34em.
